fields.resource_capacity: typed integer B/H/charge/artifact_bytes, B=root stable thread count,H=0,charge=B+max(1,H)≤8, artifact≤150GiB

process_identity: exact boot UUID/PID/PPID/PGID/start_ticks + process_before/after + threads/threads_before/threads_after; sorted unique per-thread boot/PID/process_start/TID/start_ticks
ancestry: ordered full identity chain root.ppid through ppid=0, no cycle/reuse, same boot, start not newer than root
creation: before exact root; after exact root+child; retired exact root; matching Popen.wait identity and returncode; every census full typed identities and exact charge; no cached authority
handshake: actual already-running driver identity request is prebound by Main before capture exec/child creation; no predicted PID or replacement root permitted
